note: Public repositories we study or draw on for interface patterns. Listing is not an endorsement. Always read each repository's own LICENSE before reusing code, and prefer reusing patterns over copying source. Links were not fetchable from GoldBrief's build environment; verify them in your browser.

items.name: Ant Design
items.what: Enterprise-oriented React component library with a large set of data-heavy components (tables, forms, charts of controls).

items.name: Chakra UI
items.what: Accessible React component system built around style props and design tokens.

items.name: MUI Material UI
items.what: React implementation of Material Design components.

items.name: Mantine
items.what: React components and hooks library with a broad component set.

items.name: Fluent UI
items.what: Microsoft's design system components for web.

items.name: Carbon Design System
items.what: IBM's open design system with guidance and components.

items.name: Primer React
items.what: GitHub's React component library and design system.

items.name: Base UI
items.what: Unstyled, accessible React components from the MUI team, for building your own look.

items.name: Radix Primitives
items.what: Low-level accessible UI primitives for React (dialogs, menus, tabs).

items.name: Headless UI
items.what: Unstyled accessible components designed to pair with Tailwind CSS.

items.name: React Spectrum
items.what: Adobe's accessibility-focused component and hooks collection.

items.name: shadcn/ui
items.what: Collection of components you copy into your own codebase rather than install as a dependency.

items.name: daisyUI
items.what: Component class names and themes for Tailwind CSS.

principles: Prefer semantic HTML and native controls before adding a library.
Choose components with documented keyboard and screen-reader behaviour.
GoldBrief Build 1 ships no UI framework dependency; these are references for patterns such as focus management, tokens and responsive layout.
Record the license before copying any code.
